problems.quote: The theory of plate tectonics, first articulated by Alfred Wegener and later refined by Harry Hess
problems.problem: Alfred Wegener proposed continental drift (1912), not plate tectonics; plate tectonics was developed in the 1960s primarily by Harry Hess (seafloor spreading) and others like J. Tuzo Wilson.
problems.correction: Plate tectonics, developed from Harry Hess's seafloor spreading hypothesis, builds on Alfred Wegener's continental drift idea
problems.verifierReason: Wegener proposed continental drift, not plate tectonics; correction accurately attributes plate tectonics to Hess et al. and Wegener as precursor.

problems.quote: uses the same stanza to reflect on the death of his brother
problems.problem: Wordsworth's "Elegiac Stanzas" uses quatrains, not the Spenserian stanza, and it meditates on Peele Castle, not his brother's death.
problems.correction: uses quatrains to reflect on Peele Castle
problems.verifierReason: Original misidentifies stanza and subject; correction correctly notes quatrains and Peele Castle focus.

problems.quote: The poem’s serial publication mirrors the periodical culture that shaped Victorian reading habits.
problems.problem: In Memoriam was published as a complete book in 1850, not serially.
problems.correction: The poem’s book publication reflects Victorian reading habits.
problems.verifierReason: In Memoriam was not serialized; correction correctly states book publication.

problems.quote: orthogonal to the maximum compressive stress
problems.problem: Joints form perpendicular to the minimum principal stress (σ3), not the maximum compressive stress (σ1).
problems.correction: orthogonal to the minimum compressive stress
problems.verifierReason: Joints form perpendicular to σ3 (minimum compressive stress), not σ1. Correction is accurate.

problems.quote: The Palaeozoic Tethyan sequences of the Himalaya (e.g., the Cambrian–Ordovician Krol and Tal formations)
problems.problem: Krol and Tal formations belong to the Lesser Himalaya, not the Tethyan Himalaya.
problems.correction: The Palaeozoic sequences of the Lesser Himalaya (e.g., the Cambrian–Ordovician Krol and Tal formations)
problems.verifierReason: Krol and Tal formations are Lesser Himalayan, not Tethyan. Correction correctly reassigns them.

problems.quote: predicting a 90 % concentration reduction after 12 years of natural attenuation
problems.problem: The decay constant λ = 0.001 day⁻¹ gives a 90% reduction time of ~6.3 years (ln(10)/λ), not 12 years.
problems.correction: predicting a 90 % concentration reduction after ~6.3 years of natural attenuation
problems.verifierReason: Original 12-year claim incorrect; λ=0.001 day⁻¹ yields 90% reduction in ~6.3 years (ln(10)/λ).

problems.problem: Sitanshu Yashaschandra edited the Gujarati literary magazine Kavilok, not Kavita.
problems.verifierReason: Sitanshu Yashaschandra edited Kavilok, not Kavita; correction is accurate.
